auth_token.description: AuthToken is a write-only service Bearer credential; only has_auth is returned. Empty is valid for services without authentication.

base_url.description: BaseURL is the service root, without credentials, query or fragment; the server appends /mcp and enforces its outbound allowlist.

name.description: Name is unique within the current class; renaming does not rewrite skill references.

bearerAuth.description: HS256 JWT，8小时；退出撤销账号旧Token。转换产物使用HTTP bearer，输入JWT本身。

info.description: 处理器注解生成的实际契约。Bearer每请求核验当前身份；Week4 Ask无据零模型调用，Week5无据仍生成。材料UUID、1-based切片；无公开会话DELETE。
info.title: CampusClaw Go API

get.description: 教师可看本班全部；学生只看启用项。班级来自Bearer身份。

post.description: 完整字段必填，两个绑定数组不可为null。空prompt使用默认助教角色；空材料不检索，仍生成。绑定仅允许本班资源。

get.description: 学生读取停用、外班或不存在项均404；教师可管理本班停用项。

put.description: 完整字段必填。修改/停用/解绑下一轮生效，正在生成及历史快照不变；停用只禁止新建会话。

requestBody.description: 完整配置，空数组合法，null或省略拒绝

post.description: question/mode输入，answer/sources输出；不写会话或注入教师技能。无命中固定“资料中未找到相关内容”、sources=[]、对话调用0次。有据非法引用502，依赖故障503。
接受JSON或表单username/password。无Cookie，角色/班级由数据库确定；退出撤销旧Token。

requestBody.description: 登录凭据（JSON或同名表单字段）

post.description: 只接受agent_id。本班无启用助手400；外班/不存在/停用404。已有会话可在助手停用后续聊；不得换绑。
post.summary: 学生创建锁定智能体的私有会话

get.description: owner+当前class限定；外班/他人/不存在404，教师403。保留失败前缀和最终引用；done丢失时据此确认completed，不自动重试模型。首问标题前24个Unicode字符。
get.summary: 本人会话及完整消息历史

post.description: 仅content，trim后2–500字，owner+class限定，单会话并发409。原子保存user/assistant占位，准备本轮快照和末尾6条历史（含当前user一次，每条历史≤500字），再meta/Flush，之后才连接模型。有据/无据均生成，空绑定不检索；无据不虚构数字引用。每片先落库再delta，completed提交后done；15秒心跳。meta.citations是完整候选/空数组，done.citations是实际引用子集且保留原号。meta前参数/权限/准备故障返回JSON（503可能已保留failed轮次），meta后模型连接/生成/引用/持久化失败保持HTTP200 + error，无成功done。取消保留interrupted草稿；EOF无done请读历史确认，不自动重试。Swagger即时增量请使用实时SSE面板。

no_evidence.summary: 空候选仍调用模型，清洗数字引用

502.description: 仅meta前模型输入预算校验失败；模型尚未连接

503.description: meta前准备或数据库故障，模型尚未调用

post.summary: 学生发送问题并读取实时SSE

no_evidence.summary: 空候选仍调用模型，清洗数字引用

get.description: 不接受客户端scope查询参数；使用可信当前班级。

500.description: 存储故障为HTML500，身份故障为JSON500

post.description: 仅一个file，最大20MiB，不允许身份覆盖字段。先提交原文；RAG启用时返回index_status，索引失败仍201且原文保留。

get.description: 不存在/外班统一404；正文是数据，不提升为系统权限。
校验当前班级及文件完整性，附件名称清理路径/控制字符；支持Range。

post.description: 空对象使用默认策略；size默认800，overlap默认size/10且必须小于size，delimiter策略需要非空delimiter。失败不删除原文或改历史引用。
post.summary: 教师重建本班材料索引

get.description:
Teacher only; class comes from current verified Principal. Legacy authentication storage failure remains 500; MCP database failure is 503.
Lists only the current class. has_auth is a boolean, never the credential; connected and tool_count reflect persisted connection/cache state.

post.description:
Teacher only; class comes from current verified Principal. Legacy authentication storage failure remains 500; MCP database failure is 503.
Registers configuration without connecting or calling tools. auth_token is write-only; base_url is a service root and must pass the configured server-side allowlist. Response contains has_auth only.

delete.description:
Teacher only; class comes from current verified Principal. Legacy authentication storage failure remains 500; MCP database failure is 503.
Unaudited servers are physically deleted with 204. Existing append-only audits prohibit deletion and return 503; no force-delete or audit purge exists.
delete.summary: Delete unaudited server; audited deletion returns 503

put.description:
Teacher only; class comes from current verified Principal. Legacy authentication storage failure remains 500; MCP database failure is 503.
Omitted or empty auth_token retains the previous credential. Every update disconnects and clears cached tools. Rename does not rewrite tool@server skill references; update and resave skills explicitly.
put.summary: Update configuration; empty token retains; clears cache

post.description:
Teacher only; class comes from current verified Principal. Legacy authentication storage failure remains 500; MCP database failure is 503.
Uses stored service Bearer credentials for initialize then tools/list; does not call tools/call. Successful discovery atomically replaces cached tools. Remote/protocol/authentication failure is 502, not browser JWT revocation.
post.summary: Initialize and discover tools; remote failures 502

post.description:
Teacher only; class comes from current verified Principal. Legacy authentication storage failure remains 500; MCP database failure is 503.
Idempotently marks disconnected and removes cached tools; does not delete audits or skill source. Subsequent resolved calls are denied and append terminal audit records.

get.description:
Teacher only; class comes from current verified Principal. Legacy authentication storage failure remains 500; MCP database failure is 503.
Returns only cached name/description/inputSchema fields. Does not discover or invoke tools, and does not return credentials or internal revision.
get.summary: Read cached tools without network I/O

get.description:
Teacher only; class comes from current verified Principal. Legacy authentication storage failure remains 500; MCP database failure is 503.
Returns only the current class, newest terminal records first. Default 50, maximum 100 (larger positive limits clamp); detail is a safe summary, not raw arguments or remote errors.
get.summary: Read current class terminal audit records newest first

get.description: 固定top4；keyword零Embedding，向量阈值0.35及RRF保持；依赖故障503不降级。本接口nil材料范围为本班，不采用Week5空绑定语义。
已登录用户可读本班技能原文、解析字段、启用状态和版本；写操作仅教师。

post.description: 名称/适用条件/启用必填，空行后为正文；source≤8000、名称1–32、条件1–120、资料≤32、正文1–2000个Unicode字符。保留原文；班内重名400，非法UTF-8/字段/工具拒绝。

delete.description: 清理当前绑定，历史技能名/配置/证据快照不重写；外班或不存在统一404。

get.summary: 读取本班技能原文与元数据

put.description: 仅接受source完整文本或enabled-only二选一；混合/null/未知字段400。开关原子同步source与解析元数据。下一轮生效，历史不改。
